Kieran Trippier has been asked to pick his best ever teammates.

The former Newcastle United star tasked with picking his top eleven he’s played alongside.

Kieran Trippier turned 36 last month and is now with Wolves as he he looks to help get them back into the Premier League.

The former England defender has of course had a long and decorated career, for both club and country.

As well as for the national side and Wolves, Kieran Trippier has previously played for Newcastle United, Tottenham, Burnley, Atletico Madrid and Barnsley.

The full-back started his career at Manchester City but never made a first team appearance.

Kieran Trippier went out on loan before making a permanent move to join Eddie Howe when he was managing Burnley.

So here are the starting eleven of best ever teammates that Kieran Trippier has played alongside in his career:

Jan Oblak
Kyle Walker
John Stones
Toby Alderweireld
Danny Rose
Marcos Llorente
Mousa Dembele
Koke
Son Heung-min
Luis Suarez
Harry Kane

An interesting choice, any Newcastle United players you think should have been included? Danny Rose ahead of Lewis Hall???
